title: A La Carte Items in the Graduate Rollover to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
A graduate rollover to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account counts the snacks the student buys: when a la carte items were rung up on the account in the month before the rollover date, what was spent on them in that month is added; when none were rung up in that month but some were in the month before it, what was spent on them in that earlier month is added; otherwise nothing is added.

A date falls within the N months before the rollover date when fewer than N whole calendar months separate it from the rollover date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month or, when that later month has no such day, on the first day of the month after it. The month before the rollover date is thus the dates within the one month before it, and the earlier month is the dates within the two months before it that are not within the one month before it.

| A la carte items in the month before the rollover date | In the earlier month | Added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | what was spent on them in the month before the rollover date |
| none | yes | what was spent on them in the earlier month |
| none | none | nothing |

## Example

Hypothetical: a rollover date of April 20, 2027, with a la carte items of 1.25 and 2.00 rung up on April 6 and nothing else in the two months before it: 3.25 is added. Had the last items been 1.75 on March 8, nothing in the month before but 1.75 in the earlier month, 1.75 is added.
